meta.title: Quantity counter offer for partial awarding per line item

plan.title: Quantity Counter Offer for Partial Awarding

steps.note: Open the prepared RFQ QCS containing a vendor bid.

args.goal: In the RFQ Master QCS, click Counter Offer beneath the vendor's name, select the Quantity field, enter a reduced quantity for the line item, click Send Counter Offer, and stop with the success feedback, Counter Offer Requested tag, and the quantity cell showing the original and counter-offer quantities highlighted.

steps.note: Perform the quantity-specific counter-offer flow and verify its success feedback and quantity comparison on screen.
Assert that the vendor's bid is marked with the Counter offer initiated status.
